definitions: An update or improvement to a system or software that occurs without any noticeable interruption or disruption to the user's experience.
A transition to a newer version of a product or service that is smooth and does not require any additional effort or action from the user.
examples: The company promised a seamless upgrade to the new operating system.
Users appreciated the seamless upgrade of their mobile app.
Achieving a seamless upgrade was a key design goal.
